entries.title: Command-Return on iPhone and iPad no longer sends an empty message after yours
entries.body: With a keyboard attached to your iPhone or iPad, pressing Command-Return twice quickly, or holding it down, now sends your message once. Before, a second press that arrived before the message box emptied on screen could send an empty message right after yours.
entries.noPicture: The message box looks as it did before; the change is that a quick second press now sends nothing.
